notes: Side view, facing east (No.10 right-footed: the near/right leg kicks with the OUTSIDE of the boot, ankle turned IN; the far/left leg plants). Not mirrored (no west strip). Points are pixel indices (studioAnim adds 0.5; contact lands on the bottom edge of row 102). bbox = [x0,y0,x1,y1] measured on the art. Registration: the Trivela canvas = the Approach/Run canvas + originDx 56 px (exactly GALE's Strike canvas). contact = the planted toe-tip column on row 102: the far (left) toe (76,102) on T3-T8b (the plant never slides; flat on T3-T6, on the toes T7-T8b), the near (right) toe (94,102) on T9/T9b. ball = the 12 px ball centre (87,96) on T3-T6 (wide of and a little ahead of the plant); at T5/T6 draw the ball OVER the sprite (nearer the camera than the boot). boot: T4 = the heel at the top of the knee-flick backswing (35,79); T5 = the outside of the boot low behind the plant (50,92); T6 = the outside contact point (80,96) (bootPart outside; the ball's back edge is x 81), so shot 1 crops T6 x4 on boot. head = skull point; eye: T7 the half-closed profile eye, T8a/T8b the OPEN eye of the 3/4 face (glint), T9/T9b the profile eye following the pass. Shot 3: AP1 0.00, AP3 0.09 (Approach strip), T3 0.18, T4 0.40, T5 0.55, T6 0.62-0.84 (ink freeze), T7 0.84, T8a 0.95, T8b 1.15, T9 1.30, T9b 1.50-1.70; shot 5 = T9 0.5x cache. T9b is a review-round-2 addition (T9 was held 0.40 s): pelvis/contact/legs = T9, head/torso/arms 1 px up, mop settled. Studio layer: Art only (numbers in Art; no Num/Ball layer, MERIDIAN plan §7.7). The ball is never drawn in a frame: the game draws it at ball/boot.
